name: Brass Hellhound Packfiend
loreTies: A court-bred pursuit beast used by Infernal houses to chase oathbreakers through Gate corridors and enemy lands.
Fast pressure unit that surrounds and exposes the Deity.
source culture humans later copied as hell, demonology, and infernal contract lore
shortBackstory: Brass Hellhound Packfiend is a lore-faithful Infernal Dominion run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Brass Hellhound Packfiend belongs to The Infernal Dominion and exists to express Infernal Dominion law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Fast pressure unit that surrounds and exposes the Deity.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Lean brass-armored hellhound, coal eyes, ash mane, molten claw seams. Abilities — Pack Lunge, Scent of Debt, Ash Snap — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
